title: IN WHICH FIX, THE DETECTIVE, BETRAYS A VERY NATURAL IMPATIENCE
summary_hover: At Suez, Detective Fix awaits the steamer Mongolia, hoping to catch the bank robber, and is soon approached by a passenger with a familiar passport.
summary_detail: Detective Fix and the British consul pace the wharves at Suez, anticipating the arrival of the steamer Mongolia. Fix explains his strategy for identifying the bank robber and firmly believes the suspect will pass through Suez. Once the ship arrives ahead of schedule, a passenger approaches Fix to ask for the consulate, handing over a passport that perfectly matches the description of the wanted man.
